thread:
maya: Hey all — putting a short checklist + example manifest for qprofile lifecycle and packaging. Need quick review before I drop into optimize docs.

samir: thanks maya. can you call out compatibility rules for model/quant pairs? e.g. awq -> only GPT2-style currently?

maya: good q. initial compatibility matrix we propose: AWQ/GPTQ -> transformer-decoder only, int8/FP8 -> transformer-encoder/decoder hybrid ok. I'll include mapping in manifest.

jordan: can we standardize namespace so infra can route variants? suggestion: <model>-<precision>-<variant>-v<semver> e.g. "mistral-7b-awq-rc1-v0.1"

maya: yes, namespace suggestion + reason: routing + fallback resolution. add also a `compatibility` field in the bundle manifest that lists supported runtime kernels and min/runtime version.

tia: minimal checklist looks good. add a note to include a small regression prompt set and pass/fail thresholds. we keep those in `evals/` inside the bundle.

maya: exactly. here's the draft manifest (v0.3) to include in optimize recommendations: 

```json
{
  "name": "mistral-7b-awq-rc1-v0.3",
  "model_family": "mistral",
  "base_size": "7B",
  "precision": "awq",
  "variant": "rc1",
  "semver": "0.3.0",
  "compatibility": ["runtime>=2.5.0", "kernel:awq-v1"],
  "benchmarks": {
    "latency_ms_p50": "40",
    "throughput_rps": "120"
  },
  "evals": {
    "regression_suite": "evals/regression_prompts.json",
    "accuracy_delta_threshold": "-0.002"
  },
  "packaging": {
    "format": "qprof-v1",
    "contents": ["weights.bin", "qconfig.pb", "evals/", "README.md"]
  },
  "signing": {
    "signed_by": "eng-ml:maya",
    "signature": "<base64>"
  }
}
```

samir: nice. minor: rename `accuracy_delta_threshold` -> `max_allowed_delta` and document that negative means drop from fp32 baseline.

maya: done. also adding `fallback_policy` so runtime can pick a compatible variant when this profile fails. e.g. `fallback_policy: ["mistral-7b-int8-v0.2", "mistral-7b-fp8-v0.1"]`.

jordan: any thoughts about including quantization seed/recipe metadata? reproducibility is important for GPTQ.

maya: added a `quant_recipe` pointer to packaging, and `quant_seed` field. important for audits.

tia: +1 on audit fields. also request we add a short `notes` freeform so PMs can signal known regressions or tradeoffs.

deploy-bot: deploy check: manifest v0.3 schema passes validator on staging. artifact size 2.1GB, signed.

maya: awesome — I'll update the Optimize recommend doc with the manifest example, namespace rule, and the checklist: 1) local bakeoff against baseline, 2) record evals + thresholds, 3) sign + release tag, 4) register in qprofile catalog, 5) add fallback policy.

samir: can we add a short CLI snippet for pack/unpack? would help SEs.

maya: yes, i'll add before merging. thanks for the fast reviews :thumbsup:
